$comment: What may leave the sk.oto vault. Read by wiki/sync/sync-vault.mjs. Allowlist, not denylist: a folder that is not named here is never published, so new vault folders (data_sources/, _drafts/, .agents/ ...) stay private by default.
$comment_phase: Phase 1 (2026-09): only the six subspecialty maps of content go out (gate.tierMatches), and the root MOC.md stays home. To open the full set: set tierMatches to "" and includeRootFiles to ["MOC.md"].

gate.$comment: A note is published only if its frontmatter passes. 'statusIn' empty = any status.

unvetted.$comment: When vetted is empty, add this tag and put this callout under the H1, so an unverified note never reads as a reference.
unvetted.callout:
> [!warning] Unvetted
> Study scaffolding, not yet verified against source texts. Not a clinical reference.

feedback.$comment: Appended to every published note: a link to the correction issue form in the wiki repo (wiki/github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/correction.yml). 'field' is the form input the vault path prefills; pull-feedback.mjs reads it back.
feedback.text: *Spot an error? [Suggest a correction]({url}) — opens a public GitHub issue.*

holdIfBodyMatches.$comment: Fail closed: a note matching any of these is held back and listed in the report for a human to look at. Tuned for PHI and credentials, not clinical vocabulary.
